about: Intro walkthrough (spec v0.11 §6.5). Steps target data-tour attributes in the reader; a missing target shows a centred caption. Edit wording here; no code change needed.

steps.title: Welcome to Bible Zoom
steps.text: Bible Zoom shows the layers of meaning around the text: how it is written, what it refers to, and how it has been read. Let’s explore the six days of creation in Genesis 1.

steps.title: Move around the Bible
steps.text: Choose a book and chapter, or type a reference like “John 3:16”. Zoom from the whole Bible down to single words. At Chapter zoom the layers show as colour only.

steps.title: Zoom in for detail
steps.text: At Section zoom the coloured bands get labels. Go further to Verse or Sentence to see every word.

steps.title: Choose your layers
steps.text: Layers above the text are interpretive: genre, structure, metaphor, modes of reading. Layers below are evidence about the words themselves: names, grammar, the original Hebrew and Greek. Tick any layer on or off.

steps.title: One chapter, several readings
steps.text: Scholars read Genesis 1 in different ways: {genre}. Bible Zoom shows them side by side in a striped band, never ranked.

steps.title: Open any band
steps.text: Every band opens a card. “What this means for reading” explains the layer and each reading, and every reading names who holds it.

steps.title: See the pattern
steps.text: The structure layer shows the days one to seven. Some readings of the chapter build on exactly this pattern.

steps.title: Ask about any words
steps.text: Select words, like “And God said”, and the Ask bubble opens about them. Send it to your own ChatGPT or Claude, or run a model on this device. Nothing is sent until you press a button.

steps.title: Keep your own notes
steps.text: Add your own layers, tags and notes to any passage, and share them with friends. Notes need a free account.

steps.title: Find it all again
steps.text: Everything you write is gathered in My notes, in the account menu. Replay this tour any time from the ? button. Enjoy exploring!
